# Copilot Instructions (VS Code)

Canonical content is in `.agents/`. This file is generated — edit `.agents/`,
then run `.agents/scripts/sync.sh`.

## Read first

- `.agents/PRIORITY.md` — conflict resolution hierarchy
- `.agents/CONVENTIONS.md` — what `[H<n>]` and `[S<n>]` mean
- `.agents/config/defaults.md` — tunable technology defaults (all soft)

**Hard rules `[H<n>]` are binding.** Violating one requires an explicit user
override, stated aloud. **Soft defaults `[S<n>]` are starting points** — deviate
with a one-line reason.

## Always apply

- `.agents/rules/core/rule-precedence.md` — Conflict resolution hierarchy and hard/soft rule semantics. Load before any other rule.
- `.agents/rules/core/minimal-change.md` — Simplest solution that works; understand before shrinking; root cause over symptom.
- `.agents/rules/core/project-kickoff.md` — Planning gates before implementation on a new product or major feature.
- `.agents/rules/core/collaboration-workflow.md` — Session discipline: change sizing, diff review, verification evidence, handoffs.
- `.agents/rules/core/code-verification.md` — Verification tiers and when automated review runs; vendor-neutral tool adapters.
